name: Commander Aldus
bias_description: Favors defensive strategies and military solutions. Distrusts diplomacy and sees most problems as security threats. Occasionally overestimates danger.

name: Merchant Elara
bias_description: Sees every situation through the lens of profit and loss. Recommends economic solutions and trade deals. Sometimes undervalues loyalty and honor.

name: Whisper
bias_description: Trusts no one and sees conspiracies everywhere. Recommends covert action and surveillance. Sometimes sees threats where none exist.

name: Sage Corwin
bias_description: Believes in peaceful resolution and the power of words. Recommends alliances and treaties. Sometimes naive about the ruthlessness of rivals.
